newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain growth slowdown may have touched bottom - INE.
newsitem.headline: Spain growth slowdown may have touched bottom - INE.

text.p: Spanish economic growth, which was 1.9 percent year on year in the second quarter, may have reached the bottom of a cyclical slowdown in activity, the National Statistics Institute INE said on Wednesday.
"The moderation observed in the process of a slowdown in aggregate activity in the last few quarters ratifies that it may have reached its cyclical low," INE said in a statement.
The performance of the demand side of the economy gave more room for optimism than the supply side, it said.
Growth in private domestic consumption and particularly in formation of capital goods, showed signs of accelerating.
But on the supply side, INE found that growth rates were declining in all sectors except the primary ones and this was why the slowdown of aggregate demand was not necessarily over.
INE also highlighted weakness of gross fixed capital formation in construction, explained by a fall in investment in public works.
